# VisiaEngine

> Multi-dimensional (2D/2.5D/3D) spatial visualization engine — Rust core + wgpu renderer, C-API SDK form. Open Core (MIT OR Apache-2.0).

## Docs

- [rustdoc reference](build/docs/index.html): generated API documentation (pixi run docs-gen)
- [whitepaper](docs/whitepaper.md): positioning, roadmap, commercial model (single source of truth)
- [architecture](docs/architecture.md): design baseline (crate layering, D4 wgpu ruling)
- [SDD contracts](docs/sdd/): behavior clauses, two-way traceable to tests (scripts/spec-trace.sh)
- [tutorials](docs/tutorials.md): E-numbered example index (filename = header = index lock)

## Crates

- [`visiaengine-core`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-core): Scene/EntityId slab, AttrSet typed columns, camera math, D7 rebase
- [`visiaengine-render`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-render): Backend-agnostic IR: Frame/MeshDesc/StrokeSeg/PointMark/LabelMark/Instance, PostEffect family, pick predicates (REND family), morph/anim sampling
- [`visiaengine-render-wgpu`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-render-wgpu): wgpu backend: 6-variant pipeline family, shadow/PCSS, post chain (bloom/outline/tonemap/SSAO/haze), EDL, multiview, offscreen readback
- [`visiaengine-io-gltf`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-io-gltf): GLB loader: meshes/materials/textures, load report + repair policy
- [`visiaengine-io-points`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-io-points): PLY point clouds (ascii/bin_le): typed 4-class error report
- [`visiaengine-io-text`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-io-text): fontdue raster labels: glyph atlas/shelf packing, LTR layout (latin + CJK host-injected fonts)
- [`visiaengine-io-tiles`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-io-tiles): MVT vector tiles: hand-written protobuf decode, slippy scheduler (FileSource/HttpSource), pump budget
- [`visiaengine-io-hdr`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-io-hdr): .hdr (RGBE) equirect decode for HDRI environment/background
- [`visiaengine-geo`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-geo): GeoJSON -> Web Mercator -> tessellation -> style-expansion pipeline (GEO family)
- [`visiaengine-capi`](https://docs.rs/visiaengine-capi): C ABI surface (44 entries, visiaengine.h): handle fences, input, tiles, scene tree, labels, clip, minimap, events — three-face mirror (header/hpp/wasm)

## Examples

41 example cards (E101..E901), three-way locked (files = tutorials = registries),
gallery at build/gallery/index.html (pixi run gallery). See docs/tutorials.md.
